question.text: How many posts will Donald Trump publish on Truth Social on November 26, 2026 (ET)?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the number of posts that the Trump's Truth archive (https://www.trumpstruth.org/search) lists for Donald Trump's Truth Social account (@realDonaldTrump) with timestamps on November 26, 2026 in America/New_York time — the timezone in which the archive records and displays all timestamps. To resolve, set that page's date-range filter to start 2026-11-26 and end 2026-11-26, display 100 results per page, and count every listed post, with original posts, quote posts, and reblogs each counting as one; for example, if 34 posts are listed for that date, the question resolves to 34. This search-listing count is the primary method and prevails if it differs from any other figure on the archive, such as the "Daily posting volume" chart at https://www.trumpstruth.org/stats. Posts that are later deleted still count if the archive lists them for that date. If the archive is unavailable or does not yet list that date at resolution time, resolution waits for it to be restored, falling back to another complete archive of the account's posts per [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions); if no count can be established, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: All timestamps are in America/New_York time: the counting window runs from 00:00 ET to 23:59 ET on November 26, 2026, so a post made at 12:30 a.m. ET on November 27 falls outside the window.

research:
I've pulled the archive counts and am writing up the findings now.

For Oct 17 to Nov 15, 2026 it shows 1,195 posts (39.8 a day), with 6 p.m. as the busiest hour. [stats](https://www.trumpstruth.org/stats)
- Daily counts from the archive's search listing, which is the resolution method (all ET):

  - Nov 5: 6

  - The archive says 85 results for Nov 4 to 13. My hand count comes to about 86, so a single day may be off by one. [search Nov 4-13](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2026-11-04&end_date=2026-11-13&per_page=100), [search Nov 14-16](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2026-11-14&end_date=2026-11-16&per_page=100)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet; the target day is 10 days away.
- The key point: after the midterms his posting dropped sharply, from about 67 a day before the election to about 9 a day since (Nov 4 to 15). That is far below the 40-a-day figure in the question background. The 30-day average still looks high only because it includes the pre-election surge.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-15: At 8:42 a.m. ET he posted "I am in the White House having meetings on many subjects." The post followed days of reduced public visibility and online death rumors. He left for his golf club at 10:14 a.m. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/trump-white-house-post-golf-club-visit-death-speculation-1832361)
- 2026-11-14/15: Posts attacked Judge Ana Reyes over "Trash Island" (East Potomac Golf Links) and Newsom over death-row commutations. The FAA posts called for Congress to fund air traffic control. [Rawstory](https://www.rawstory.com/trump-golf-course-2678406037/), [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/donald-trump-resurrects-hannibal-lecter-in-wild-attack-on-gavin-newsom)
- 2026-11-14: Mediaite reported that his first post that day came after a gap of about 16 hours, during the nationwide FAA ground stop. [Mediaite](https://www.mediaite.com/politics/trump/trump-fails-to-mention-flight-chaos-in-first-truth-socialpost-in-more-than-16-hours/)
- 2026-11-11: A Veterans Day graphic about Republican midterm losses in Texas. [indy100](https://www.indy100.com/politics/trump/donald-trump-texas-election-results-2678401587)
- In the Nov 4 to 15 posts I read, I saw no Epstein-themed posts. I did not check this thoroughly.

## 4. Base rates (Thanksgiving Day counts from the archive)
- 2022-11-24: 39 posts. [archive](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2022-11-24&end_date=2022-11-24&per_page=100)
- 2023-11-23: 22 posts. [archive](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2023-11-23&end_date=2023-11-23&per_page=100)
- 2024-11-28: 9 posts, as president-elect. [archive](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2024-11-28&end_date=2024-11-28&per_page=100)
- 2025-11-27: 4 posts (1:50 p.m., then 11:25, 11:26 and 11:27 p.m.). The day before (Nov 26, 2025) had 18, and the day after had 8. So the archive does not show the "day-long series" described in the question background; the immigration posts were bunched late at night. [archive](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search?start_date=2025-11-26&end_date=2025-11-28&per_page=100)
- Seasonal pattern: Thanksgiving has been below his typical daily pace in recent years (2025 averaged about 18 a day overall, but Thanksgiving had 4). This year's current pace (about 9 a day since Nov 4, ranging from 3 to 23) is below the 2025 annual average. Days with no posts remain rare.
- I could not find what his normal pace was in mid-November 2025 for a direct comparison of the run-up to Thanksgiving, beyond the Nov 26 to 28 counts above.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Kalshi, posts on Nov 15, 2026: 5-9 at 73%, 10-14 at 24%. This matches the 7 posts the archive shows so far.
- Kalshi, posts in the week Nov 15 to 21: prices are widely spread. The most likely bucket is 60-79 at 17-19%; 100-119 is at 17% and 200+ at 7%. Kalshi may count differently from the archive.
- Polymarket, Nov 10 to 17: 60-79 at 53.5%, 40-59 at 21%. For comparison, the archive shows 55 posts for Nov 10 to 15.
- Polymarket, Nov 17 to 24: spread out, with 40-59, 60-79 and 80-99 each around 15%.
- Polymarket usually resolves on a different tracker, so its counts may not match the archive.
- I found no market for Nov 26 or Thanksgiving specifically.

## 6. Upcoming events before Nov 26
- The White House turkey pardon will probably happen around Nov 24 or 25. In 2025 he flew to Florida the same day. I found no reporting yet on his 2026 Thanksgiving plans. [ABC7](https://abc7news.com/post/turkeys-waddle-gobble-arrive-white-house-ahead-thanksgiving-pardon-ceremony/18208205/)
- The House floor vote forced by Massie's Epstein discharge petition has no date I could confirm. A vote during Thanksgiving week could prompt posts.
- Other ongoing topics that could drive posting:
  - FAA and aviation crisis funding fights in Congress
  - the court case over the Reyes golf course
  - the fallout from Republican midterm losses
  - Senate confirmations and reconciliation in the lame-duck session
  - the Iran war and peace talk
- Health and visibility rumors: if he stays out of public view, his posting could stay low.
- Deleted posts: Kalshi's November deletions market prices "at least 5" at 55%. Deleted posts still count if the archive lists them.

Sources: [stats](https://www.trumpstruth.org/stats), [archive searches](https://www.trumpstruth.org/search), [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/trump-white-house-post-golf-club-visit-death-speculation-1832361), [Mediaite](https://www.mediaite.com/politics/trump/trump-fails-to-mention-flight-chaos-in-first-truth-socialpost-in-more-than-16-hours/), [Rawstory](https://www.rawstory.com/trump-golf-course-2678406037/), [Daily Beast](https://www.thedailybeast.com/donald-trump-resurrects-hannibal-lecter-in-wild-attack-on-gavin-newsom), [indy100](https://www.indy100.com/politics/trump/donald-trump-texas-election-results-2678401587), [ABC7](https://abc7news.com/post/turkeys-waddle-gobble-arrive-white-house-ahead-thanksgiving-pardon-ceremony/18208205/)

The archive shows 3 to 23 posts a day from November 4 to 15, 2026, far below the 40-a-day 30-day average quoted in the background. That average is inflated by the run-up to the election. - 2025: 4, against an 18-a-day year

- 2023: 22

(e) **Historical variation:** Daily counts are very volatile.
- Within the last two weeks they ranged from 3 to 23.
- Over the past month they ranged up to 190.
- A late-night reblog spree can easily produce 30 or more posts on a single day.
- Over 10 days the regime can shift, for example from an Epstein discharge-petition vote or lame-duck fights.

(f) **Markets:** There is no market for November 26.

- Taken together, the markets imply a slightly higher pace than the archive's recent count, before any holiday effect.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- Low: He spends the holiday at Mar-a-Lago with family, or health or visibility issues persist, and he posts only one greeting or nothing at all (0-1 posts).
- High: An Epstein files floor vote or release, or a fight over the Reyes golf-course ruling, sets off a late-night reblog spree of 50-80 posts, as happened on several 2025 nights.
